name: logitropic-plugins
description: Directory of popular Claude Code extensions including development tools, productivity plugins, and MCP integrations

plugins.name: conductor
plugins.description: Conductor is a set of modular AI agent skills for Claude Code that enables Spec-Driven Development to specify, plan, and implement software features.

plugins.name: build-ios-apps
plugins.description: Build iOS apps with workflows for SwiftUI UI work, refactors, performance audits, and simulator debugging.

plugins.name: build-macos-apps
plugins.description: Build, run, test, debug, instrument, and implement local macOS apps using Xcode, SwiftUI, AppKit interop, unified logging, and shell-first desktop workflows.

plugins.name: game-studio
plugins.description: Design, prototype, and ship browser games with guided 2D and 3D workflows, asset pipelines, and playtesting support.

plugins.name: github
plugins.description: Inspect repositories, triage pull requests and issues, debug CI, and publish changes through a hybrid GitHub connector and CLI workflow.

plugins.name: xcode-tools
plugins.description: Let agents access your project and Xcode capabilities using the Model Context Protocol.

plugins.name: documents
plugins.description: Create and edit document artifacts in Claude.

plugins.name: presentations
plugins.description: Create, edit, render, verify, and export presentation slide decks. Use when Claude needs to build or modify a deck, slidedeck, presentation deck, slide deck, slides, PowerPoint, PPT, PPTX, .ppt, or .pptx file.

plugins.name: spreadsheets
plugins.description: Create, edit, analyze, visualize, render, and export spreadsheets in Claude.

plugins.name: codex-security
plugins.description: Codex Security workflows for security scans, analysis, and investigation.

plugins.name: product-design
plugins.description: The Product Design plugin is built for turning early ideas into prototypes teams can review. It starts design and build work by confirming the brief, then helps teams explore product directions, audit user flows, prototype from a live URL, and make static screenshots interactive.

plugins.name: openai-templates
plugins.description: OpenAI default document, presentation, and spreadsheet templates.
